title: Senior/Lead Python Engineer
description:
WHAT WE ARE BUILDING

Mimica https://www.mimica.ai/careers is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

In this role, you will own and support the development of backend systems that interface with ML models. You will build pipelines, apps and core components of our ML systems, deliver new AI features and drive improvements to our infrastructure and services.

We are currently looking for Engineers to join one of our teams. You’ll go through one shared interview process, and we’ll match you with the team where your experience has the most impact:

 - Mapper Team owns our process-mapping product, turning that activity into detailed maps of how work gets done.

 - Maker Team builds our newest product, which turns those maps into bots and automations.

In all cases, we're looking for a Senior/Lead-level engineer to join the Python Chapter, who will have the opportunity to shape our technical direction, architecture, processes and culture, and to level up the team and Chapter in development practices.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Write Python applications that are resilient, robust, and integrate well with other apps in a service architecture.

 - Develop integrations and services that communicate between different backend components and with Google Services.

 - Work closely with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers throughout the lifecycle of productionising their models, building and supporting ML-driven applications (in Maker, this includes our Computer Use Tool).

 - Furthering Developer Experience (DevEx) by mentoring others in writing code that is intuitive, clear, and easy to test.

 - Developing observability for new and existing ML applications and GenAI/LLM integrations, making use of the Grafana Stack (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo).

 - Being responsive to incidents regarding ML applications - including an understanding of how to triage and resolve issues relating to CPU, memory, and GPU utilisation.

 - Documenting procedures and guides to facilitate knowledge sharing and help other engineers level up through pairing and mentoring.

 - Participating in hiring and onboarding new team members; taking on end-to-end project management responsibilities as we grow.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with previous Senior/Lead level of responsibilities.

 - Strong proficiency with Python and Backend-Engineering.

 - Strong experience with async/concurrent programming.

 - Experience owning projects from start to finish, including speccing, architecture, development, testing, deployment, release and monitoring.

 - Strong skills in building maintainable tests.

 - Strong experience with observability and tracing.

 - Knowledge of best practices for performance optimisation and memory management.

 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills – methodically decomposing systems to identify bottlenecks, determine root causes, and implement effective solutions.

 - Experience mentoring others, especially in good software development practices, patterns, and fundamentals.

 - Drive to continually develop your skills, improve team processes and reduce technical debt.

 - Fluency in English and ability to effectively communicate abstract ideas, complex concepts and trade-offs.


BONUS: YOU'VE DONE ONE OF THESE BEFORE

 - ML to production: built async Python services on top of ML models (Miner, Mapper)

 - Agent harnesses: built the runtime layer that runs agents in production (state, context, memory, orchestration), not just LLM API calls or prompt chains

Also a plus: early-stage or scale-up experience.




WHO YOU ARE NOT

 - You're not a Junior or Mid-level engineer. While we value mentoring, coaching, and curiosity, at this stage we're looking for Senior+ Engineers to help lay a solid foundation before expanding to junior engineers.

 - You use Python, but you're not familiar with its fundamentals. In this role, we're looking for people who can set standards, have seen good practices and can explain and defend technical options.

 - You don't have experience with complex architectures. We have a high technical bar, as we're building with scalability in mind, so this role would not be a good fit if you have a shallow understanding of architecture and networking of data-intensive applications.
   
   


RECRUITMENT STAGES

 - Stage 1 | Recruiter Screen with Technical Recruiter

 - Stage 2 | Take-home Challenge (async) + Follow-up (Live) - with engineers from the Python Chapter

 - Stage 3 | System Design (Live) - with an Engineering Manager + someone you'd work closely with

 - Stage 4 | Final / Behavioural Interview - w

description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations : Lisbon or London or NYC or Austin
About the Department
The Workers team makes it possible for Cloudflare customers to run JavaScript and WebAssembly on Cloudflare's edge network. We build and maintain the developer platform that executes trillions of requests per month on behalf of developers and grants them nearly limitless control over how their requests are handled and responded to. The Workers team is split into several groups. The Data Primitives group is focused on how we bring state to the edge.
About the Team
The Data Primitives Group enables developers to build with data and asynchronous tasks, taking their applications beyond simple request manipulation to complete, globally delivered applications. We build and operate Cloudflare D1 , our managed SQLite database; Queues , our messaging primitive; and Workers KV , a global low-latency key-value data store. We also design and build new services to address critical customer application integration requirements.
What you'll do
In this role, you'll join one of our top-notch engineering teams (D1, Queues or Workers KV) that keep our services and customers’ applications running smoothly at global scale while implementing new features, ensuring reliability, and improving performance.
You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write or review a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, modify how your service processes and stores data, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You will use your experience to mentor and guide other engineers as they begin their careers. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Typescript, Go, Rust, and C++.
Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience
• 5+ years of experience with (and love for) distributed systems and data
• Willing and eager to share knowledge, and mentor
• Great oral and written communications skills, especially concisely documenting complex conceptsSolid understanding of TypeScript and Go, including asynchronous programming in both
• Strong systems level programming skillsUnderstanding of security issues and responsibilities
• Experience with monitoring, alerting and debugging high volume production systems
• Experience with a continuous integration workflow and using source control (we use git)Solid Linux experience
• Fluent in analyses of data sets such as logs
• Designing and building APIs
• A desire for continuous learning and improvement
Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.
• For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66 ,000 - €83,000
• For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $231,000
Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.
Benefits
Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.
Health & Welfare Benefits
• Medical/Rx Insurance
• Dental Insurance
• Vision Insurance
• Flexible Spending Accounts
• Commuter Spending Accounts
• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
• Global Travel Medical Insurance
Financial Benefits
• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
• Life & Accident Insurance
• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
• Employee Stock Participation Plan
Time Off
• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build, lead, and scale a high-performing Solutions Engineering team that accelerates enterprise growth, delivers exceptional technical sales experiences, and helps customers unlock the full potential of n8n's AI-powered automation platform.

As we rapidly expand across Americas, you'll play a key role in developing our Solutions Engineering function and enabling your team to succeed. Here's how you'll make an impact:

Lead and develop a high-performing Solutions Engineering team

 - Manage, coach, and develop a regional team of Solutions Engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 - Support team growth through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and career development, ensuring your team is equipped to succeed as we scale.

 - Build effective team structures, processes, and ways of working to support regional expansion and evolving business needs.

Drive technical excellence throughout the sales cycle

 - Guide your team through complex enterprise sales cycles, from initial discovery and technical validation to negotiations and deal closure.

 - Coach Solutions Engineers on delivering impactful product demonstrations, proofs of concept, and technical solutions that address customer challenges.

 - Provide strategic and hands-on technical guidance when needed, helping your team navigate complex opportunities and accelerate new business and account expansion.

Partner across teams to accelerate revenue growth

 - Collaborate closely with Sales and Sales leadership to align technical strategies with commercial priorities and support successful enterprise deals.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Product Marketing to share customer insights, resolve technical challenges, and strengthen sales enablement.

 - Coordinate with post-sales teams and Forward-Deployed Engineers to ensure smooth customer handoffs and support technical validation for expansion opportunities.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

 - 👥 Experienced pre-sales leader: You have at least 2 years of experience managing and developing pre-sales or Solutions Engineering teams, ideally within a high-growth B2B software environment.

 - 🚀 Proven people manager: You have a track record of coaching, mentoring, and developing technical talent while building high-performing teams and supporting their growth.

 - 🤝 Enterprise sales expertise: You have strong experience navigating complex technical sales cycles, including discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, technical validation, and negotiations.

 - 💻 Strong technical foundation: You have the technical depth to understand complex software solutions, advise your team, and engage confidently with technical stakeholders.

 - 🔗 Relevant industry experience: You've worked with technical software products in areas such as data platforms, databases, data integration, or data flows, and understand the challenges faced by technical buyers.

 - 🌍 Regional location: You're based in the UK, Ireland, or Germany to support our growing EMEA Solutions Engineering organisation.

Nice-to-haves

 - 🤖 AI-first mindset: You're excited about the potential of AI-driven automation and have experience working with AI technologies or within an AI-focused company.

 - 👨‍💻 Coding experience: You have hands-on experience with programming or scripting, enabling you to better understand technical integrations and automation workflows.

 - ⚡ Technical software vendor experience: You've worked at a technical software vendor, ideally in a fast-growing SaaS environment, and understand how to scale pre-sales teams alongside a rapidly expanding sales organisation.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to shape and scale a critical function at one of Europe's fastest-growing startups. You'll build and develop a regional Solutions Engineering team, influence how we win complex enterprise opportunities, and help bring the power of AI-driven automation to businesses worldwide.

You'll have real ownership over how your team grows, develops, and operates, with the visibility and cross-functional influence to make a meaningful impact on our commercial success. You'll join a collaborative, remote-first company that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, where your leadership will directly contribute to our next stage of growth.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.
